title: Vendor
description: A single vendor entry in the sovereignty-vendors dataset. Every YAML file under `vendors/` must validate against this schema.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Must match the filename (minus .yaml).

name.description: Human-readable vendor name as it appears on their marketing site.

contracting_entity.description: Legal name of the entity that appears on the customer's contract / DPA (e.g. 'Supabase, Inc.', 'Cloudflare, Inc.', 'Scaleway SAS').

ultimate_parent.description: Ultimate corporate parent. Same as contracting_entity for independents; different when the vendor is owned by e.g. Alphabet / Amazon / Microsoft.

parent_jurisdiction.description: Country / bloc of the ultimate parent's incorporation. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or 'EU' for the bloc.

entity_jurisdiction.description: Country / bloc of the contracting entity. Often the same as parent, sometimes different (e.g. an EU subsidiary of a US parent).

hosting_regions.description: Regions where the vendor stores customer data (short codes as they appear in the vendor's own docs).

subprocessors.description: Slugs of other vendors in this dataset that this vendor uses as subprocessors (e.g. `aws`, `gcp`). Cascades in the scoring model — a red subprocessor pulls the overall rating down.

eu_alternatives.description: Slugs of EU-headquartered alternatives in the same category. Used to suggest swap candidates on the checker's report page.

transfer_mechanism.description: How the vendor claims to legalize transfers of EU personal data. `none` = no transfer occurs (fully EU-hosted, no US access).

operational_access_regions.description: Countries where support / SRE staff can access production data. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes or 'EU' for the bloc. This is the most commonly overlooked transfer channel.

one_line_reason.description: One-sentence explanation of the overall rating, written for a non-lawyer developer. Displayed on the checker's per-vendor card.

sources.description: URLs OR relative paths under sources/. At least one required — a rating without a source is not a rating.

last_reviewed.description: Date of the most recent review, YYYY-MM-DD. CI flags entries older than 180 days.

notes.description: Optional maintainer note. Not shown on the checker's public card.

self_disclosure.description: Set true for Eurobase's own entry so the checker's UI can render a conflict-of-interest banner. Do not set on any other vendor.

jurisdictionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, DE, FR, IE, SG) or the special value EU for the bloc.
